_notes.sections: in order. para: the voiced paragraph (voice/A.mp3, voice/A-aligned.json). in/out: seconds in it, inside pauses (out left out = its end). words: [first, last exclusive] of the paragraph's words. tail: silence after. fade: 12 ms fades where a word was cut out. own: true in a second cut's plan for the sections only it has.
_notes.pages: the section's words again, broken for the frame. The count must match words exactly.
_notes.titles: word: the spoken word (index in the section) the headline names; it lands six frames before it. until: the word whose headline replaces it. Left out: from the start, to the end.
_notes.camera: per section: line = the talking clip (plates/<line>/), line_at = where that clip's sound starts in the paragraph, enter/leave = whether they defocus in and out. Top level: where each clip sits. wide = drawn width of the 16:9 plate in px, cx = its centre x, y = its top.
_notes.grades: saturation, tint r g b, gain, the scene's light colour on the edge, how much of it.
